title: 剪纸小城
style: layered cut-paper theater, warm yellow cardstock, orange accents, pale blue stage
beats: The orange cheek unfolds into a row of three tiny paper houses
Roofs pop upward one by one
A small paper sun peeks over the middle roof
The face leans toward the miniature street
The sun lowers and roofs fold down
Houses accordion-fold back into the cheek
